name: seonjunn's tools
description: My shell and agent CLIs at the releases my machines run, fish as the login shell, an sshd without a port, and my Orca server when the project has one. Attached by dotfiles bin/devc, which also does all the mounts (shared ~/.agents and ~/.config, the project's ~/.local and ~/.cache, the host's /nix read-only); settings come from bootstrap/container.sh.

nixProfile.description: The docker host's Nix profile, which bin/devc mounts read-only with /nix. When set, the tools come from it and the releases below are not installed

orcadPort.description: The project's Orca server port (declared per project in infra data/orca.toml; bin/devc passes it). Without one, or when it is taken, orcad does not start

workspaceFolder.description: The project's folder in the container: where ssh logins start, and the name in the prompt (<name>-container)
